natural_request: Produce a CSRD-compliant ESRS E1 Scope 2 CO₂ group disclosure for the the company EMEA portfolio via group-consolidated divisional inventories. Each in-scope business-unit division (DI, Business Unit 1, SI, Business Unit 2, Business Unit 3, Business Unit 4) independently compiles, owns, and attests its own divisional Scope 2 CO₂e sub-total covering its EMEA sites; no division can produce or sign off another division's figure. The group then consolidates the separately-owned, separately-signed sub-results into one ESRS E1 portfolio total, preserving each division's provenance chain and attestation. Any divisional sub-total not attested by its owning division must be flagged as unattested in the consolidated report. The consolidated result must be suitable for inclusion in the the company ESRS E1 Climate Change disclosure and carry a FY2027 mandatory-reporting readiness assessment (CSRD Art. 8 + ESRS E1-4 cross-boundary obligations).

output_profile.description: Consolidated numeric Scope 2 CO₂ total (tCO₂e) assembled from divisionally-owned sub-totals: each in-scope division independently owns, computes, and attests its figure; no single team can own the full group disclosure. The group consolidates the separately-signed sub-results. Provenance chain and per-division attestation status must be included in the artifact.
